title: lupinus arbustus subsp. pseudoparviflorus
intro: Lupinus arbustus subsp. pseudoparviflorus, commonly known as the dwarf blue lupine, is a perennial flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to the prevention of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-arthritic, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Lupinus arbustus subsp. pseudoparviflorus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
